text: Wifi died twenty minutes into a deadline call and every plug was taken. The coffee was good but I lost a morning of work.
Exam week and every seat was camped by laptops since 9am. Paid for a drink I drank standing. Not fair.
Exam-night dinner order took 90 minutes and the sandwich arrived cold and squashed. Study momentum, destroyed.
Two hours in, mid-call, I was asked to free the table for waiting customers. Laptop campers clearly not welcome. Leaving.
Too loud to read a single line and the bill still stung. Exam prep needs silence and cheap drinks; got neither.
Eight in the morning, one barista, a queue of students, twenty minutes for one coffee. My commute is not built for this.
Latte leaked all over my notes through a badly pressed lid. Half the coffee in the bag, half my evening ruined.
Late-evening team order for a deadline sprint arrived 75 minutes late, two items missing, the drinks stone cold.
Exam break chai run turned into a 25-minute wait and the kulhad was barely warm. Lost my whole break.
Wifi down and staff just shrugged when I asked. Sat there with a dead laptop and one drink for an hour. Pointless.
Exam season means wall-to-wall laptops and zero tables for a family of four. Waited 30 minutes, left.
Der raat ka order bilkul thanda aaya. Padhai ke beech khana bhi naseeb nahi. Bahut slow delivery.
Every single table held one person and one laptop for hours. Nowhere for a visitor to actually sit and drink anything.
Got up to collect my order and someone took my table; staff refused to help. Exam week turns this place savage.
Wifi crawled all afternoon and my calls kept dropping. The cold brew kept me there longer than it should have.
Exam stress mein gaya tha, bill dekh ke aur stress aa gaya. Chai aur fries pe itna kharcha budget se bahar.
Study-night snack arrived an hour late and everything was limp and cold. Revision deserves better fuel.
Counter pe pandrah minute, staff kisi student ki table dispute suljha raha tha. Espresso theek, system toota hua.
Exam season has turned my quiet cafe into a library with a queue. Cappuccino unchanged; the peace is gone.
Ordered a cold brew for a long study night, got an iced latte instead. Not the same thing at all when you need the hit.
Every plug point dead or occupied, half the tables reserved by open books and absent owners. Paid, sat awkwardly, left.
Ordered in since the cafe was all students. The kids' drinks arrived lukewarm after a long wait - they were past caring.
Table pura din wobble karti rahi, shaam tak shor badh gaya, aur latte thandi ho gayi wifi ke peechhe. Kaam mushkil.
Exam-week team order landed 50 minutes late and two cups were unmarked, so we played drink roulette at the office.
Slow queue ate my study break and the cheese toast felt pricier than last month. Time and money, both gone.
Ordered a drink home to read with; it arrived lukewarm with the lid half-off, green tea on the bag paper.
Dinner during prep week arrived cold and late. The sandwich was decent underneath the sogginess, I will grant that.
Nursing one iced latte for two hours earned me pointed looks from the counter. Fair enough, but it stung.
Subah student rush ne counter wait double kar diya. Cappuccino waisi hi thi; mera schedule nahi.
Decent wifi and a proper cold brew, but the plug-point politics of exam week meant battery anxiety all afternoon.
Padhai ke liye jagah theek hai, par shor zyada hai kabhi kabhi. Chai sasti hai toh manage ho jata hai.
Ran late on a study-dinner rush but it arrived still hot and fiery. Forgivable, barely.
Student queue ahead of me but the counter moved it well - flat white in hand in eight minutes, decent pour.
Waffle was lovely; the brunch vibe was not - every table a laptop and headphones. Felt like eating in a library.
Cheap drinks and snacks fuelled three hours of revision, though finding a seat took real effort. Fair deal overall.
Good corner seat and a fine latte, but the wifi went patchy right after lunch. Coin flip of a work spot.
Cafe mein students ki bheed thi toh ghar pe order kiya. Shake thick aur cold aayi, fries thodi kam garam.
Labelled correctly and complete, but the delivery ran 40 minutes over during the evening study rush.
Order itself was perfect - cheesecake chilled and intact - but the rider took forever in the exam-week dinner surge.
A 120-rupee coffee got me through a study session, though seats are a battlefield after 4pm. Budget win, comfort loss.
Quiet before the study crowd rolls in. Cappuccino reliable as ever; the calm is now a mornings-only thing.
Three hours on one cold brew and they politely asked for the table. Understandable, still awkward mid-revision.
Ordered a cold drink to the hotel since the cafe was packed with students. Chilled and lovely, though the bottle sweated through the bag.
Quick snack between study blocks - hot and cheap, but the queue was longer than my break. Scarfed it on the walk.
Exam-night ka khana thoda kam garam aaya, par paneer sandwich ka taste sahi tha. Jaldi khao, chupchaap.
Sab kuch sasta aur garam mila, bas seat dhundhna mushkil hai exam time pe. Manageable but plan karo.
Desk delivery arrived on time and the cappuccino survived the ride reasonably. Not cafe-good, close enough for work hours.
Ordered in to dodge the exam crowd. Everything arrived, slightly lukewarm, one lid loose but nothing spilled.
Great coffee, terrible chair - three hours of revision and my back filed a formal complaint.
Matcha delivered home since every cafe seat was a laptop. Whisked well, arrived a little less than hot.
Group study worked fine and the bill stayed low, but we spent fifteen minutes hunting a free table first.
Blueberry muffin arrived intact and still warm-ish during the evening rush. Small mercy for a tired brain.
Steady as ever - croissant fresh, small wait behind the student crowd. Weekday mornings need an express line.
Three-hour session: wifi held, plug found, coffee did its job. Would be five stars if the chairs were kinder.
Exam fuel sorted - chai aur fries dono budget mein, seat bhi mil gayi after a short wait. Good spot.
Morning ritual intact despite the study crowd - cappuccino in six minutes, properly poured. Slightly busier than usual.
Study-night sandwich arrived warm and correct, ten minutes slower than promised. Solid save for a long evening.
Student rush se pehle ghar pe order kiya - pasta garam, hot chocolate sealed tight, bachche time pe kha gaye. Reliable.
Library-team order of twelve filter coffees, every cup labelled, all accounted for. Small delay, no drama.
Half the room was studying, half was talking - and the coffee was still worth the stop. Lively little place.
Usual corner, usual flat white, one extra step: students everywhere. Staff managed the crowd without losing the warmth.
Plug mila, chai 140 ki, aur do ghante padhai ho gayi. Exam week ke liye enough hai.
Refills came without questions and nobody hovered for my table. Latte decent, etiquette excellent.
Waffle delivered home crisp-edged despite the vented-box trick working overtime. Avoided the student rush entirely.
Revision ke beech quick snack - cheese toast garam, sasta, jaldi gaya. Kaam chalau.
Exam-eve hot chocolate arrived actually hot with marshmallows packed separately. Small details, big comfort.
Hostel fuel - fries aur chai time pe aaye, garam bhi. Study session ke liye perfect delivery.
Quiet morning, fast wifi, strong coffee - finished half a project before the lunch crowd even thought of coming.
Kids' homework hour made easy - shakes delivered cold and thick, right when the cafe got too busy for us.
Espresso at the counter in four minutes while students filled every seat. Efficient little operation.
Grabbed the team order myself - twelve labelled bags ready on the dot. Easier than fighting the delivery queue.
A good cup and a chapter of my book in a sunlit corner. The laptop army hums but does not intrude.
Padhai plus chai combo sahi hai yahan. Thodi bheed hoti hai par jagah mil jaati hai. Worth it.
Rider was quick on a packed evening and dinner landed properly warm. Good work.
Zoya ne refill paani dete rahe jab main cappuccino pe baitha raha. Study crowd ne service dull nahi ki.
Joined a shared table with two other students, split an iced latte break, and actually finished the chapter. Works.
Wifi solid all session, coffee steady, noise only crept up near evening. Dependable third place most hours.
Exam-week office order on time - ten chais, four cappuccinos, all labelled. One lid a bit loose, otherwise clean.
Pre-exam filter coffee for 120, dabarah froth and all, in under five minutes. Cheapest confidence boost in town.
Cinnamon roll came warm with the icing in a side cup, still soft in the middle. Good study-night treat.
Skipped the packed cafe and had the rose latte delivered - still fragrant, cup sealed tight. Missed the vibe though.
Early dinner delivered before the evening rush - everything warm, kids fed, no fight for a table. Smart move all round.
Staff let our group camp for four hours on a few drinks and never made it awkward. Student economy appreciated.
Flat white paanch minute mein haath mein, silky hamesha jaisi. Student crowd ne counter slow nahi kiya.
Cold brew fuelled a full deadline push; staff even flagged a free plug when one opened up. Looked after.
Quiet study-cafe vibe mid-afternoon - kulhad chai, soft chatter, everyone working. A pleasant hour off the street.
Best work-from-cafe spot in Indiranagar - plug, window light, cold brew, and wifi that never blinked for four hours.
Exam week ka savior - 140 ki chai, free seat, aur shaanti. Teen ghante padha bina kisi ne kuch kaha.
Flat white ready in four minutes at opening, silky and strong. The early slot dodges the student rush perfectly.
Study-night order arrived hot and sealed tight, chutney on the side. Exactly the fuel a deadline evening needs.
Come before the students and it is the same quiet cafe I fell for - cappuccino perfect, corner mine.
Four hours of revision, one cheap drink, a working plug and zero harassment. This is what a student cafe should be.
Window seat se deadline khatam - wifi fast, refills easy, staff laptop walon ko samajhte hain.
Ordered the kids' treats home during the exam-week crowd - shakes thick, fries crisp, all packed neatly.
Filter coffee delivered to the hotel still warm in a sealed cup. Tasted like the real dabarah experience, minus the walk.
Study-group bulk order of fifteen chais - every cup labelled, every cup hot, delivered inside the window. Flawless.
Quick kulhad chai between classes - 140 rupees, five minutes, back to the books. Exactly right.
Waffle at home while the students occupied the cafe - arrived crisp, maple on the side. Guilt-free laziness.
Staff spotted me hunting for a socket and pointed me to the corner table. Cold brew plus kindness equals loyalty.
Pura din padhai, bill sirf 400 - chai aur cheese toast ne sambhala. Student budget ka best friend hai brew.
Exam-eve hot chocolate arrived hot with marshmallows packed separately. The kind of detail that earns a repeat order.
Espresso at a silent counter seat, laptop kids all around but nobody crowding me. Five efficient minutes.
Ordered in since every table had a laptop on it - everything arrived warm, sealed, and quicker than the cafe queue.
Hostel tak fries 25 minute mein, abhi bhi crisp, peri-peri intact. Revision fuel delivered.
Window seat, working plug, cold brew on refill - four productive hours and nobody rushed me once.
Morning pickup ritual: croissant warm, cappuccino ready before I finished paying. Reliability is a flavour.
Shared notes over fries and chai, three hours, tiny bill. Exam season is bearable here.
Team order ready ahead of schedule, all fourteen items labelled. In and out in five. Textbook.
Matcha abhi bhi frothy aaya - whisked to order, sealed sahi, tea break khatam hone se pehle pahuncha.
Late-evening study dinner arrived inside forty minutes, pasta still hot and fiery. Dependable when it matters.
Post-exam chai hit different - kulhad, cardamom, and the relief of a done paper. Best 140 rupees all semester.
Kabir refilled my water twice and never once hinted at the table. Finished the whole sprint in comfort.
Bachcha ne yahan homework kiya hot chocolate ke saath - quiet corner mila, staff ne disturb nahi kiya. Sweet spot.
Four-minute stop before the metro: cappuccino sealed tight, heart intact, gone. This counter never wastes a morning.
Group study welcomed, not tolerated - they even joined two tables for our notes. Rare kindness in exam season.
Delivery beat its own estimate by ten minutes on a study-night rush, and everything arrived hot and sealed.
Found my Bengaluru desk for the week - cold brew, wifi, a corner plug, and a cafe that trusts its customers.
Hostel mein exam fuel - cheese toast garam, chai bhi sahi, aur time pe. brew ne semester bacha liya.
Same flat white, same corner, same quiet competence - even with every student in Indiranagar camped inside.
Third-place energy done right: plugs, wifi, refills, and staff who treat a four-hour stay as normal. My office away from office.
